label: SYNTHETIC throughout; no real personal, insurer, payment, or cloud data
money_unit: integer minor units (paise); 100 paise=INR1; no floating point

scenario.matching_rule: Health A/B/C use the same fully specified SYNTHETIC scenario. Motor and changed-scenario fixtures cannot be price-ranked against it. No real DOB, PIN, medical answer or contact data.

quote-health-A-revision2.purpose: Increase by 10,000 INR minor units (paise); explicit acceptance of the exact revised quote is required.

quote-health-A-revision3.purpose: Decrease by 10,000 INR minor units (paise) versus the initial quote. Calculate against confirmed netPaid; do not issue successive refunds blindly.

state_variants.application-A-paid: Same stable application-A ID in a separately named isolated seed; payment confirmed, ONBOARDING; not auto-submitted.
state_variants.application-A-reviewed: Exact current revision, scenario/quote/configuration/terms hashes and totals accepted; disclosures complete; reconciliation complete.
state_variants.application-A-submission-pending: Explicit authorized submit after all gates; durable SUBMISSION_PENDING; no external reference yet.
state_variants.application-A-submitted: Distinct isolated seed/state variant with reviewed revision plus SIMULATED_INSURER external reference evidence; SUBMITTED only here. Not an actual transition run or real insurer submission.

source_status_rules: SYNTHETIC values are visibly labeled and isolated from recovered evidence.
Recovered ECOS-55 illustrations/base tariffs/historical tariff cells remain SOURCE_EVIDENCE, not accepted payable quotes.
VERIFIED describes a particular attributable field/source assertion only, not underwriting acceptance or launch readiness.
UNKNOWN stays nullable/Unknown; missing tax or total blocks payable review.
No real actor or PII is created from these aliases.
Immutable source versions retain original hashes; draft/revision replacements get new IDs/versions and explicit source-status labels.

alias_crosswalk.A: customer-A when used as applicant; source-A is public wording alias, never customer identity
alias_crosswalk.B: customer-B when used as applicant; source-B is public wording alias

lifecycle_requirement: Each seed is independently named and reset. Paid/submitted states are supplied test fixtures only. Production state-transition evidence must be generated by the actual tested flow.
application_revision_key: Composite(application_id, revision bigint); no revision UUID.
